node.title: A=1 core-one nonzero-weld trace descent
node.statement: On the official A=1 core-one maximal-degree sharp cap, every nonsaturated-domain trace of the nonzero weld has an exact gcd factorization K_x=-H_xJ_x whose complementary Q-degree is delta_x+epsilon_x; the deficits sum to C_*. If D_*=1, the exceptional-slope trace has a saturated gcd of degree at least e+3b and complementary quotient degree at most c+1. Exhaustively, either one of these traces is active, or B_XE_Z divides K and factor allocation reduces the weld to W_1B_1-1=QK_1 with nonzero K_1 in a smaller degree box. Neither branch is excluded.
